mapper.insert: insert into classic_id_generated (strategy, id_count, last_id, elapsed_millis) values (#{strategy}, #{idCount}, #{lastId}, #{elapsedMillis})

insert into classic_lock_lab_result (mode, expected_count, actual_count, lock_acquired, lock_timed_out, lost_updates, elapsed_millis) values (#{mode}, #{expectedCount}, #{actualCount}, #{lockAcquired}, #{lockTimedOut}, #{lostUpdates}, #{elapsedMillis})

insert into classic_rate_limit_lab_result (biz_key, algorithm, limit_count, window_seconds, attempts, first_burst_allowed, second_burst_allowed, distributed) values (#{bizKey}, #{algorithm}, #{limitCount}, #{windowSeconds}, #{attempts}, #{firstBurstAllowed}, #{secondBurstAllowed}, #{distributed})
